description: Get Product by ID. The "Get Product by ID" API allows to retrieve information for a specific product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single product based on the provided product ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getProductById
